events.title: The birth of Karol Wojtyła
events.shortBlurb: The future Pope John Paul II was born in the Polish town of Wadowice…
body: On 18 May 1920 Karol Józef Wojtyła was born at Wadowice in southern Poland. He lost his mother, brother, and father while still young, lived through the Nazi occupation working in a quarry and a chemical plant, and studied for the priesthood in a clandestine seminary in Kraków.

Ordained in 1946, he rose to be Archbishop of Kraków and cardinal, and in 1978 was elected Pope John Paul II, the first non-Italian pope in more than four centuries. His pontificate of nearly twenty-seven years was among the longest in history, and he was canonized in 2014.
